intro: The Tome of Divinity is a foundational step in the training of paladins devoted to the Holy Light. Bestowed to guide aspiring champions in Stormwind, the holy teachings emphasize that true divinity lies in humble virtue, compassion, and patience rather than raw martial power or a quest for godhood. Under the watchful eye of Duthorian Rall, initiates must embody these lessons through service to the needy and vulnerable across the kingdom.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: In all things, a paladin must reflect the Light which supplements our strength. To strive to be divine for one of our kind does not mean we strive for godhood--we strive to be good in all actions.

Although called upon to smite evil in these harsh times, you must always remember that it's aiding others that will truly set you apart from the citizens of Azeroth. Compassion, patience, bravery--these things mean as much to a paladin as strength in battle.
Know this well, and never forget it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hello again, friend. How goes your studies of the Tome of Divinity?

Then you should be prepared to have yourself tested. There are always tasks to be done throughout the city and our lands; acts of compassion and understanding; people who need help; creatures to slay.
By proving you have the patience to help others, especially those who are less fortunate, you prove that you are a servant of the Light and of sound mind.
